definitions.gloss: engraved mark; stamp; hallmark; (to) engrave, imprint
definitions.explanation: A mark cut or pressed into a hard surface such as metal, leather, or a seal, often to show a maker, purity, or authenticity. As {刻印|こくいん}する it means to engrave or stamp such a mark, and figuratively to leave a lasting impression on the mind.

examples.japanese: ⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刻印|こくいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an engraving on the ring.

examples.japanese: {金|きん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{純度|じゅんど}→純度：18774_jundo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧{刻印|こくいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{押|お}されている→押す：02854_osu⟧。
examples.english: A hallmark showing the purity of the gold has been stamped on it.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{光景|こうけい}→光景：02799_koukei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刻印|こくいん}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That scene is still etched into my memory.

notes:
Compound of {刻|こく} (to carve) + {印|いん} (mark, seal). Used both for a physical engraved mark and, with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, for the act of engraving or leaving a deep impression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {刻印|こくいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to apply a stamp/hallmark
- {刻印|こくいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to add an engraving
- ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{刻印|こくいん}⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be etched into memory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {刻印|こくいん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to engrave, to imprint — the verb use
- {烙印|らくいん}: brand mark — burned in, often figurative as a stigma
- ⟦{彫刻|ちょうこく}→彫刻：04448_choukoku⟧: sculpture, carving — three-dimensional carving rather than a mark
